additional_info.subject: RE: ID0418441-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P0 170001115] ENGIE VIANEO- melted DC PIN connectorRisk CRM:02684000093
additional_info.body:
Hi Guillaume Barcelo,
I hope you’re doing well.
As you mentioned, and based on the picture provided, it appears that the DC connector pin has melted. There is a risk of further melting when charging a vehicle, so as a safety measure, we recommend disabling the affected outlet until further troubleshooting can be performed.
For further analysis, if you have the following information available, could you please share it with us?
On which outlet is the issue observed—DC1 or DC2? (It appears to be the DC2 CCS2 outlet)
The total kWh delivered and an estimate of the number of charging sessions on this outlet.
Is a CMS (Charge Management System) installed?
A picture of the plug type label.
Thank you, and we look forward to your response.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
